cli:cmd:ui wait:arg:args.reason: Visible/hidden selector waits and batch wait accept the same XPath/regex structured selector; no CLI positional parser.

cli:cmd:ui wait:opt:--disappear.reason: Element presence/absence waiting is ui assert; pure delay is ui act steps op=wait.

cli:cmd:ui pinch:opt:--area-radius.reason: Supply the pixel radius as touch.radius. The default is calculated from the selected bounds.

cli:cmd:ui rotate:opt:--direction.reason: Positive touch.degrees is clockwise; negative is counterclockwise.

cli:cmd:ui rotate:opt:--radius.reason: Supply the pixel radius as touch.radius.

cli:cmd:ui scrollsearch:arg:selector.reason: to identifies the target in the selected container and does not accept index.

cli:cmd:ui scrollsearch:opt:--scroll-sel.reason: The container is explicit and uses the MCP selector object.

cli:cmd:ui scrollsearch:opt:--vertical.reason: left/right select horizontal mode; up/down select vertical mode.

cli:cmd:update.reason: Self-update of the devecocli binary; this server is updated with git/npm.

cli:cmd:update _check.reason: Internal background version check of devecocli.
